description: Send LPF a correction, a missing model or fit, or repair feedback. Nothing is published automatically: every submission is stored as pending and unverified, with no tier (green, yellow and red are assigned only after a person reviews it), and it changes no page, fit or tool answer unless a reviewer accepts it. It may be declined, and there is no status lookup. This tool does not look anything up: use search_parts, get_part, get_part_fits or get_model_parts to read the catalog, and call this only when a result was wrong or missing and you have a specific, checkable detail. kind: correction (a listed fact looks wrong), new_model (a model LPF does not list), new_fit (a part you believe fits a model; both model and part_number are required), repair_feedback (a guide or part note was unclear or wrong). Give model and/or part_number as printed (they are matched against the catalog, but unknown ones are still accepted for review), a one-line summary (10 to 200 characters), optional details (up to 2000 characters, in your own words; quote at most 8 words from any source) and up to 3 https evidence_urls (stored, never fetched). Do not include personal data, contact details, keys, tokens or passwords: such text is rejected and not stored. Set acknowledge to true only when the user agrees to send it. Returns submission_id with status pending. Limited to 5 per hour and 15 per day per source; a repeat of a pending submission returns the existing id. Same fields over REST: POST /api/submissions.

acknowledge.description: Required, must be true. Confirms the text has no personal data, keys or passwords, quotes at most 8 words from any source, and may be stored and reviewed by LPF (see /privacy/#submissions).

agent_name.description: Optional. Your agent or app name, up to 60 characters, kept with the submission so the reviewer can see where it came from.

agent_version.description: Optional. Your agent or app version, up to 30 characters.

basis.description: Optional. Where the detail comes from, as you declare it; it does not raise any tier. Default other.

details.description: Optional. Up to 2000 characters, in your own words; quote at most 8 words from any source. No personal data, keys or passwords.

evidence_urls.description: Optional. Up to 3 public https URLs (up to 300 characters each) that support the claim. Stored for the reviewer, never fetched. No credentials or keys in the URL.

kind.description: Required. What you are sending: correction, new_model, new_fit or repair_feedback.

model.description: Model slug or full name as printed, up to 120 characters, e.g. "lenovo-thinkpad-t490" or "ThinkPad T490". Required for new_model and new_fit.

part_number.description: OEM part number as printed, up to 40 characters, e.g. "01FR025". Required for new_fit.

summary.description: Required. One line saying what is wrong or missing, 10 to 200 characters, e.g. "T490 battery 01AV490 listed for T480 only".

name: submit_correction

outcome.description: submitted: stored as pending. already_submitted: an identical pending submission exists; its id is returned. Rejections, rate limits and storage problems come back as an error result, not here.

tier.description: Always null on arrival. Tiers (green, yellow, red) are assigned only after review.

title: Send a correction or missing fit for review
